**fix(governance): brain-audit config loader fails closed on unparseable brain.config.json (#962)**

brain-audit.mjs is the release gate; its loadConfig() swallowed any brain.config.json read/parse failure to {}, silently emptying governance.reviewActors (a DENY/exclusion list) and letting a bot-only-reviewed merge count as human-reviewed. Fixed by delegating to the existing loadBrainConfigOrThrow(cwd), which propagates the throw to the top-level catch (exit 2, names the config) while an absent config still resolves to {} (R11, unchanged). Two fixture tests pin this with a genuinely-empty git range so no sibling reader can flip the assertion. Classified every other config consumer in brain-audit.mjs (ignoreList, tier, auditBaseline, vcs adapter) as ALLOW/exempt, unaffected. Drafted (never promoted) a Tier 2 doctrine correction moving brain-audit.mjs into evidence-reader-empty-on-failure.md's fixed-reader roster and reclassifying approved-label.mjs as a fixed-fallback exemption rather than an ALLOW-list reader.
